summary: Comprehensive architecture and development plan for the Game Boy Color adventure game 'Legend of the Chivalric Fall: The Kingdom of Aethelgard'. Covers full 3-act story, overworld map blueprint based on user's diagram, Pokémon/Zelda GBC pixel art sprites, combat with sword and shield guard, side quests with triggers, dialogue system, 8-bit Web Audio chiptune music, and save system.
